(or any Interest Group) to perform a coup, they must be powerful (have more than 20% clout at any point and not drop below 18%), have less than 0 approval while also being a part of the government, and be opposed to the current Governance Principles or Distribution of Power.|
*Four types of coups can occur:
**Autocratic coup: Country is neither an Autocracy nor an Oligarchy and the Interest Group endorses Autocracy 
**Anti-Communist coup: Country is a Council Republic and the Interest Group opposes Council Republic
**Anti-Republican coup: Country is either Parliamentary Republic or Presidential Republic and the Interest Group opposes Republics
**Anti-Monarchist coup: Country is a Monarchy and the Interest Group opposes Monarchy
*The Armed Forces are usually indifferent to any of the laws described above. The only way to get them to care about the government is to wait for the leader of the armed forces to have a trait like Monarchist, Republican, Theocrat etc.
** Since at game start the most countries are monarchies, the quickest way to get a coup is to restart until the leader of the armed forces has the trait Republican.
** To increase the Armed Forces clout, bolster them, hire and promote their generals and admirals, expand the army, increase army funding or employ people in the military industrial complex.
** To get the Armed Force's approval below 0, fire their generals or admirals, decrease their funding or pass laws that they oppose. Be careful to not push them below -10 or they might leave the government and start an insurrection. Starting in a country that already has unfavorable laws to the Armed Forces (e.g. Tripolitania) will help.

en:
There are many ways to do it. For example, you could start as Qing, damage relations with Russia, and then declare war on them. Raise as many conscripts as you can and set all your armies to attack. Then, simply wait.


- id=\"Champagne Socialist\"

name: Champagne Socialist
en:
Best paired with the 'Paris Commune' Achievement. Releasing  fully after having deleted all wine fields in their country can help, as they also have an obsession with wine. Alternatively, trade agreements with  or  will help as both Italian cultures, Basque and Catalan also has an obsession with wine.


- id=\"Fordlandia\"

name: Fordlandia
en:
Since you need to be in top-10 GDPPC not global GDP, and engines industry is highly profitable when you switch to automated irrigation, it's easily doable with any country. Monopolies on rubber and monopolizing the Africa is an easy way to ensure you get it quickly. 
Note that the company requires researching combustion engine and having 5 levels of motors (trains) industries, not automobile industries.


- id=\"Franchising\"

name: Franchising
en:
The requirement means that another country has a regional HQ from one of your companies, not the other way around. Should be easily achievable for any profitable company given investment rights in a reasonably sized country.


- id=\"It's a Blockade!\"

name: It's a Blockade!
en:
30-40 years into the game, any great power's market capital should have enough trade centers. London is likely the first to do so.


- id=\"Swiss Bank Account\"

name: Swiss Bank Account
en:
or anyone since nobody would want them. A variant strategy is written at the end.)

** On game start, declare interests in Italy and Occitania, use Enlistment Efforts decrees on both your states and conscript the maximum amount of troops, then queue General Staff into Nationalism for research.

** When your interests have established, use a Power Bloc Embassy treaty to get money transfer (aim for ~2k) from any of the Sovereign Empire Power Bloc leaders that are protective towards you. Upon establishing this treaty, start a Diplomatic Play against Sardinia-Piedmont to conquer all of their states. For the war against Sardinia-Piedmont, you will likely have more success defending until you have General Staff, but with the conscription from National Militia you should be able to reduce their troop numbers more than they can reduce yours.

** After winning the war, incorporate Savoy and set an interest in Persia. Conquer Bahraini Hormuz from Bahrain. After conquering this state, incorporating Savoy, and researching Nationalism, change your capital to Savoy and release Sardinia-Piedmont as a subject. Grant it Sardinia and Provence, then use the Trade State interaction to give it East and West Switzerland. Declare war on France (Expel Diplomats if necessary) and they should set a \"Conquer Savoy\" wargoal as a primary. Back down to their demands and your capital will move to your only remaining state: Hormuz. Your GDP should be >10k at this point and you will be receiving ~2k in money transfer treaties so the achievement will pop.

* Alternatively, improve relations with all neighbors except . After annexing , build a power base, defeat France in a war to enforce maximum amount of money transfer (over 100k preferably), then release Sardinia and starve the two Switzerlands to death within 5 years. The GDP can be reduced to 1M and lower.}}


- id=\"Systembolaget\"

name: Systembolaget
en:
Starting as Sweden, build a Food Industry, take farms off liquor producing, then click its 'Monopolize' button in the Buildings tab.


- id=\"Venice, Vidi, Vici\"

name: Venice, Vidi, Vici
en:
Starting as . Build ~ 100 s in Venetia (You can also try less, the country with the most trade centers is Great Britain and they have about 70 at game start). Release and play as .


- id=\"Wall of Text\"

Starting as Great Qing. Negotiate a treaty with Britain involving: Alliance, trade privilege, investment rights, money transfer, goods transfer, etc. You should have 10 or more article with all these good transfers.

- id=\"I’m Feeling Hungary\"

en: - id=\"Prussia of the Balkans\"

name: Prussia of the Balkans
en:
The easiest way to play Bulgaria is by starting as Russia, and immediately demanding them be liberated from the Ottomans (if you slap on a ton of other liberations too, they'll probably back down without a war). Once they're free an event will pop up to swap to them, but since you're playing as Russia you should trade them the rest of Dobruja before you swap (they should always accept). This route is slightly better than just releasing them as the ottomans, since you get a little more land. Alternatively, you could conquer the Bulgarian states from the Ottomans and then release and play as them, this avoids  although you should probably get rid of  and  before you release Bulgaria.

From there you just need to play Bulgaria relatively normally. You can cozy up to Russia to make sure nobody will kill you, but it's not too likely to begin with. Aim to build up your economy enough first to actually complete the Prussia of the Balkans JE; You can choose to either take the Yugoslav route, or gain a bunch of free claims on most European Ottoman land (this is probably better for the achievement).

You can use your big army + Russia to beat up the ottomans, giving you even more land to build up your economy, at least until you're a GP.

'''Alternatively''': Can be done during the course of a grand  campaign where you form . Grab the Bulgarian homelands along the way or at the end. Beat up and balkanise which ever of , , or  exists if necessary. Then release and play as . The achievement is easy from there.


- id=\"Quill and Bayonet\"

name: Quill and Bayonet
en:
You must get pb in power and have secret police and autocracy to trigger the event. Then Complete 4 of the 5 requirements to complete the achievement. You can easily cheese this achievement by getting 50 relationships with the papal states and passing appointed bureaucrats before the event triggers giving you 2 of the 4 requirements. Before triggering the event set all buildings to there lowest production method then when the event starts set them back while subsidizing and subventing all industries as you maximize construction and troop count to hit the other 2 requirements. You can also annex some territory with your massive army to make sure you hit the gdp target.


- id=\"Sorbia is Serbia\"

name: Sorbia is Serbia
en:
Both  and  are potential starting countries. Can be combined with the \"David Slays Goliath\" achievement. It's arguably easier this way, because Montenegro gets a lot of military buffs that can help taking over Germany.


- id=\"Teamkiller\"

name: Teamkiller
en:
Forming Serbia and Montenegro is allowed.
Requirements to trigger the Balkan League can be found in the potential JE tab. The Spoils of War JE triggers after the Balkan wars. It used to be that you must not own all of your cultural homelands to trigger the JE, but this does not seem to be the case anymore.


- id=\"Viribus Unitis\"

name: Viribus Unitis
en:
You must not annex Hungary and instead go for the Dual Monarchy. The achievement's name is Latin for \"With United Forces\", and was the personal motto of Emperor Franz Joseph I.


}

- id=\"A Las Barricadas!\"

name: A Las Barricadas!
en:
*Forming  blocks this achievement.
*The tooltip is mildly misleading; the revolt you switch to doesn't actually have to be anarchist, you just need to switch to a revolting tag and then have anarchy enacted while at peace. This makes the achievement much easier, as it can be difficult to even get an anarchist movement to spawn.

The easiest method is to just rush the anarchism and then socialism techs (you want anarchism first so you can switch laws right after you win the war). When the coming storm event triggers after researching socialism, bolster any socialist movement & try enacting a law they hate. Sabotage the original Spanish tag by expelling diplomats & deleting the army once the revolt spawns, then switch to the socialists. From there, you just need to win and enact anarchy. 

The achievement's name is Spanish for \"To the Barricades\", and is the title of an anarchist anthem popularised during the Spanish Civil War.


- id=\"Unanimity\"

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
en:
Note that the convinced interest groups have to be opposing, not just neutral. Also note that if an interest group opposes the change but has a high enough approval that they won't stall the law, then they won't count.
This is seemingly inevitable if you play long enough. You'll probably be able to eke it out when you're passing , , , or other laws that multiple IGs are opposed to.


- id=\"Deconquista\"

name: Deconquista
en:
power bloc and use the  diplomatic action (requires the  DLC).|
Although you can theoretically get Spain into your Muslim religious powerbloc, it's likely that they'll either be a major or GP and thus be extremely reluctant. Thus, this achievement requires you dismantle & probably protectorate them to force swap their religion.

The strongest Muslim nations by far are the Ottomans and the Egyptians - Egypt is likely easier, since not as many AI nations hate you from the start. Once you secure your initial position, get strong enough until you can defeat Spain in at least one war - Ideally, ally France (done more easily as Egypt) or Great Britain (done more easily as the Ottomans) & pray that AI Spain pisses off their starting allies. Declare to release Catalonia, Leon, Andalusia, and any others you can fit. These releasables should be enough to knock Spain down to minor power, at which point you just need to protectorate them or convince them to join your bloc. Once they're in, wait 5 years and you should be able to forcefully swap them. Remember that in a religious convocation bloc, you need to stay on  (or ) otherwise your cohesion will get nuked.}}


- id=\"Full Circle\"

name: Full Circle
en:
Cannot be achieved starting as .
The Glorious revolution event requires you to have a coup while having >50 tension in the \"Two Spains\" Journal entry, which is unlocked after winning the initial Carlist war. You can force tension increase by just generating radicals with high taxes & having a low legitimacy government. Piss off interest groups by hiring and firing generals or sporadically trying to enact or change laws - this should get you a coup eventually.
Once the coup actually fires, you can only choose to restore the Carlists if you have an interest group with a Carlist leader in government. This is really easy if your coup leader also happened to be a Carlist, but you can also just wait out for the first election post-coup to bring in a Carlist interest group.


- id=\"One More Time\"

name: One More Time
en:
Building the Cathedral requires the  tech. The in-game requirement says something about rebuilding it three times, but if you just complete this construction and wait a bit it seems to trigger.


- id=\"Portugal Is Not a Small Country!\"

name: Portugal Is Not a Small Country!
en: - id=\"Regeneration\"

name: Regeneration
en:
This can be obtained after forming Iberia, though the JE may need to have already been active.
The JE will require having a few relatively advanced techs, namely . Most of the economic goals you need to achieve are easy, but Land reform is difficult due to requiring 15+ SOL for Spanish homelands. Ideally try to hold off triggering the JE until you have the public healthcare institution + a few companies that can produce prestige consumer goods (furniture, groceries, etc). Depeasanting these states is another way to boost your SOL.


- id=\"Sugar Rush\"

name: Sugar Rush
en:
*Forming the  does not block the achievement.
*Play normally, improve relations with the USA, get Support Independence from them and anyone else if you can. Damage relations with Spain. The goal is to 'fail' the \"Cuba es España\" Journal Entry, giving ticking liberty desire and the \"Un Camino Differente\" which gives even more with the \"Viva Cuba\" option. When the possible, use the \"Independencia\" Journal Entry to be purchased by the USA, the achievement might immediately complete, if not, use the USA's enormous economy to finish it off by building more sugar plantations, and potentially subsidizing sugar exports. The requirement is to start as Cuba, not to be Cuba.


- id=\"The Most United Kingdom\"

name: The Most United Kingdom
en:
/.
* For inheritance, there are unique contents introduced in IbTw for both countries, but the process is primarily dependent on the Spain and Brazil AIs (thus largely out of the player's control).
**  To inherit the Spanish throne,  needs to trigger the ''Glorious Revolution'' Journal Entry, then they need to choose one out of eight options to let the Portuguese monarch take their throne. Check the Spain content wiki page for more information.
**  Inheriting the Brazilian throne is a bit more painful. First,  needs to surpass  in GDP and prestige, which lets the Portuguese install their monarch as Brazil's heir. Then the  AI needs to \"successfully\" finish the ''Magnanimous Monarch'' Journal Entry (progress bar larger than 0 until Pedro II dies). Since the AI on its own can easily mess this up, it is recommended to help them as much as possible. The very limited and indirect means of intervention include: forming an ideology power bloc and inviting them so they can pass  and  (you need to pass them first, and Isabel needs to stay as their heir for 10 years for the progress to +30), investing in their country so they can build a large navy and become a Great Power (each +10), pray they fight a lot of wars and generate enough national heroes to complete ''Integrating the Brazilian Nation'' JE (+10, -10 if fail), and a free button that gives them +20. There are more random events for  to reduce the progress than to increase it.
*** If the progress bar is no smaller than 60 when Pedro II dies, the inheritance happens peacefully.
*** If the progress bar is no larger than 50, republicans will take over and  will have 5 years to restore union, which is a unique and nice diplomatic demand that costs negligible infamy.}}

- id=\"Everyone Disliked That\"

name: Everyone Disliked That
en:
Disapproval from unnecessary promotions seems to be based on either the interest groups of your other generals, or the clout of your interest groups. It's easy to obtain early on as Great Britain by just making a bunch of armies and promoting generals of various IGs. You can recruit agitators & set them as commanders to gain more IG variety as well. Marginalized interest groups don't seem to matter for this achievement.


- id=\"Golden Spirit\"

name: Golden Spirit
en:
can gain Ainu as a primary culture by picking pro-Ainu options whenever possible during the ''Taming the North'' journal entry. Most easily obtained by just annexing Ezochi as Japan, building 4 gold mines, and then releasing and playing as them.


- id=\"Knock Knock\"

name: Knock Knock
en:
You can add on Threaten Hostilities to a treaty that would've already been accepted to get it easily.


- id=\"Kobu Gattai\"

name: Kobu Gattai
en:
Note that this requires re-enacting  to achieve, after unlocking the Honorable Restoration JE. You can unlock the JE early by just opening up via the early game event.
Within the Honorable Restoration JE, you need to complete Arrange Imperial Marriage and then Petition for Imperial Restoration with high legitimacy. It's easiest to just re-enact Closed Borders & cancel the Dejima Trade before clicking the Arrange Imperial Marriage button. After that, you can just click both buttons with high legitimacy to obtain this.

Keep in mind that having a Open Market wargoal enforced on you also imposes a five-year period where you cannot change out of Free Trade. Because the Imperial Marriage mission also has a deadline of five years, this can result in failure if the Arrange Imperial Marriage button is clicked too early.


- id=\"Martin Anward’s Pirates!\"

name: Martin Anward’s Pirates!
en:
Easy to do at game start as Morocco, thanks to their starting navy. The AI doesn't seem to close the Danish straits and Russia and Sweden don't really seem to defend themselves, so it should be quick to obtain.


- id=\"Mikasa es su Casa\"

name: Mikasa es su Casa
en: - id=\"Nobody Did Their Duty\"

name: Nobody Did Their Duty
en: - id=\"Nothing Personnel, Kid\"

name: Nothing Personnel, Kid
en:
Very easy to do against any minor nation as a GP.


- id=\"Railroad Taikun\"

name: Railroad Taikun
en:
The Taikunate outcome only happens if you have a non-traditionalist Shogun. The easiest one to obtain is Yoshinobu, who will pop up via event at some point in the 1850s. Once he becomes Shogun, hit the Revise Reform Strategy and then Petition for Imperial Restoration with high legitimacy. From here, you just need to build the railroads and not remove your Landed Voting law or amendment.


- id=\"Son of Varmland\"

name: Son of Värmland
en:
Forming  prevents this achievement. The most reliable way to do it is to grab Zealand to have the Øresund. This should give you plenty of income to grow your economy. Then, focus on building paper mills and universities in your capital. Norway has sulfur mines, so giving them Investments Rights will make things easier. Research Railways first, then rush for monitors. You should be able to construct it by 1850.


- id=\"Thanks, Obama\"

name: Thanks, Obama
en:
Can be forced early by putting taxes on maximum & swapping the government around to be low legitimacy & gain radicals. Keep attempting to enact unpopular laws and bolstering any IGs that get mad. You can move your capital to Hokushin'etsu & build some stuff there to hopefully further reduce their revolt chance.


- id=\"Thing, Japan\"

name: Thing, Japan
en:
Noda Shoyu Co, Kinkozan Sobei and Mitsui are the best companies if aiming just to get this achievement fast, as they have profitable industries for the early game and prestige goods that are produced the moment they become prosperous.


- id=\"Three Mountains\"

name: Three Mountains
en:
After achieving independence, with some relations improvement  will usually be open to backing plays against Japan in exchange for Sakhalin. If done early enough, Japan will often fold without a fight. Japan may also get into a civil war, in which they may be willing to transfer their portion of Ryukyu if you're lucky.


- id=\"Wealth, Fame, Power\"

name: Wealth, Fame, Power
